name: OTP vs Magic link: Choosing the right passwordless authentication method
snippet:
Magic links remove the step of typing, which can reduce user friction: no risk of mistyping a code or password, just a tap to log in. This low- ...
Both eliminate the need for a user-created password, but they work in different ways: with OTP, the user is sent a code (via SMS, email, or app) which they must manually enter, whereas a magic link lets the user authenticate with a single click on a unique URL.
